dedupe_keys.name: city of san diego park locations park and recreation land

description: This dataset maps City of San Diego Park and Recreation land, including public parks and open space parks within the city, as polygons with an attribute table. Coverage: the City of San Diego. Access: free CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON, REST and file geodatabase downloads on the city portal (issued June 2016, last updated 1 May 2026, weekly update frequency). Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): PDDL-1.0. Caveats: no data dictionary is provided, so attribute meanings must be inferred, and only city-owned park land is included (not county, state or federal land). Simulation uses: open-space and cooling-refuge access, wildfire interface and flood exposure of parks, and park investment planning. Related records: the San Diego city facilities condition assessment, the TPL ParkServe layer and OSM leisure=park features.
